# Release Notes

## 0.40.4 — 2026-10-19

- Cardless manual, lifetime, and explicit administrator-granted personal access now resolves as active in PWA/API and bot without the card-binding popup. Cardless self-service payment, promo, and partner trials remain blocked and continue to receive the binding action. Runtime exact SHA `77d3600364856583ff0da6ebc9becc912f16a699` was deployed from implementation PR `#49` (`6fb4fb5dc94b97dda3493c4126666c4006947cac`) after source validation `39169384816`, exact-main validation `39169745032`, and manually approved production run `39170229882`. Deployment evidence artifact `12169477165` records `readback: passed` at `2026-10-19T07:22:31.249880+00:00`; encrypted off-host backup artifact `12169392078` was checksum-verified. Focused Django `11/11`, bot `13/13`, browser acceptance, and independent review passed. No payment, card, financial transaction, or production user data was changed. The workflow proves the shipped runtime and service health; no direct authenticated production browser session for Telegram user `288834786` is claimed. See `code/docs/releases/0.40.4-cardless-admin-grants.md`.
- Documentation-only post-deploy synchronization; no runtime redeploy.
